definitions.gloss: all day, the whole day, throughout the day
definitions.explanation: From morning until evening without interruption. A formal word often seen in written notices, schedules, and announcements.

examples.japanese: {終日|しゅうじつ}{営業|えいぎょう}しています。
{会議|かいぎ}が{終日|しゅうじつ}{続|つづ}いた。
{工事|こうじ}のため{終日|しゅうじつ}{通行止|つうこうど}めとなります。
examples.english: The road will be closed all day due to construction.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, written-style word that functions as both a noun and an adverb. Often seen on signs, notices, and schedules. In casual speech, {一日中|いちにちじゅう} is preferred.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {終日|しゅうじつ}{営業|えいぎょう}: open all day
- {終日|しゅうじつ}{運休|うんきゅう}: out of service all day
- {終日|しゅうじつ}{通行止|つうこうど}め: closed to traffic all day
- {終日|しゅうじつ}{禁煙|きんえん}: no smoking all day

SIMILAR WORDS:
{一日中|いちにちじゅう} (all day long) is the everyday equivalent. {終日|しゅうじつ} is more formal and concise, making it ideal for signs and official announcements.
